# qualtive Provider

Manage [Qualtive](https://qualtive.io) resources through the Qualtive Admin API.

~> **Alpha:** this provider is in early development. Resources, attributes and behaviour may change in any `0.x` release.

-> Until the Admin API fix for API-key roles is deployed, a key acts one role below its user's role, so writes need the key of a user with the **admin** role.

Creating enquiries isn't atomic on the server, so two creates with the same slug can both succeed. Apply with `-parallelism=1`, and don't let two configurations manage the same container at the same time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    qualtive = {
      source  = "nightshift-habits/qualtive"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# The API key is read from QUALTIVE_API_KEY when api_key is not set.
provider "qualtive" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) User API key (`u-…`) with the editor or admin role in every container you manage. Can also be set with the `QUALTIVE_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Qualtive Admin API. Defaults to `https://admin-api.qualtive.io`, or the `QUALTIVE_ENDPOINT` environment variable when set.
